title: Campsend · Send files and track delivery
excerpt: Send files free with an expiring link. Track when your delivery is first opened or downloaded.
content_html:
The simple way to send files.

Add a note, email an expiring link, and see when the delivery is first opened or downloaded.

Why I built Campsend

Hello,

Sending files doesn’t need to be this difficult.

I got tired of switching between Dropbox, Google Drive, and WeTransfer whenever I needed to send finished work to one person. Their pricing is all over the place too.

I wanted a smaller tool for delivering work.

With Campsend, you choose files, add a note, and enter the recipient’s email address. They get a link that expires after 30 days. You can see when the delivery is first opened or downloaded.

Campsend also keeps the files you send, so you can use them again without uploading them again.

That’s why I’m building Campsend. To make file sharing delightful.

Obakeng Mosadi [email protected]

See what happened.

Campsend records when a delivery is first opened and when any file is first downloaded.

What you get.

Everything here is on the free plan except where it says Pro.

  • You stop owning the link

    Every delivery link stops working after 30 days on its own. Revoke one sooner and it stops working the moment you press it. Nothing to remember, nothing to clean up in six months.

  • Your recipient signs up for nothing

    The link in the email is all they need. No account, no app, no permissions dialog standing between a client and the work you finished.

  • You upload each file once

    Everything you send stays in your library. The same deck goes to a second client without a second upload, and without hunting for it on your machine.

  • You get the signed copy back

    Turn on replies and the recipient can send files back on the same page they downloaded from. No second tool, and no asking someone to email it to you.

  • It looks like it came from you

    Your name, your logo and your color on every delivery page, on every plan. Pro puts a cover image behind it, so the page carries your work rather than our layout.

  • Your assistant can send for you

    Connect Claude, or any client that speaks the Model Context Protocol, with a Campsend API token. It can list what you have sent, tell you whether a delivery was opened, and send files you have already uploaded. Give it a read-only token and it can look without being able to send anything.

  • Your files can live in your own bucket

    Pro connects your own S3, Cloudflare R2 or Backblaze B2 bucket. New files go there instead of to us, and they stop counting against your Campsend storage.

  • You send it when you meant to

    Write it tonight, schedule it for Monday morning. The link goes out when you said it would rather than when you remembered.

Send for free or run it yourself.

Send files for free

The free plan includes 15 deliveries each month and 2 GB of storage. Delivery links expire after 30 days and can be revoked at any time.

See the free plan

A smaller WeTransfer alternative

Campsend is built for sending finished files to one person. Add a note, email the link, and see when the delivery is first opened or downloaded. If you need shared folders or file syncing, Dropbox and Google Drive are better fits.

See how Campsend compares

Run Campsend yourself

Campsend is open source. Run it on one server with your own object storage and SMTP service. Self-hosted installations have no Campsend storage or delivery limits.

View Campsend on GitHub
